protocol.scope: Feature removals change the model; unary/support reductions preserve their own variant; restricted pools are lossy. All ablations share horizon1440/grid30/operations/resources.
protocol.naive_scope: Exact variable-family count and one-hot coupling lower bound only; naive complete coefficients/couplers intentionally not claimed
protocol.selection: Development fixtures/settings fixed before outcomes; not a held-out industrial evaluation

counts.naive_scope: Eligible machine x every worker x every grid start before skill, calendar, release and duration checks; assignment family only, no complete naive QUBO claimed

parent_generation.scope: Seeded randomized topological list scheduling over raw finite domains; no time-indexed QUBO matrix built. Every complete parent independently checked.

restriction.method: Unary operation rows with parent retention and round-robin mode/timing diversity
restriction.scope: Lossy finite unary-domain restriction. Precedence, resource, travel, setup and Cmax constraints remain global. No component route frozen.

pool_reference.scope: Native raw-column-pool reference. Bound applies to this supplied restricted pool only.

raw_objective_interval.qualification: Raw CP bound plus independently raw-checked witnesses; restricted optimality is not global
